HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE JYOTI SINGH  OR % 16.11.2023 CRL.M.C. 2132/2022 & CRL.M.A. 9017/2022 (stay)
1.
Present petition has been filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for quashing of charge sheet in FIR No. 409/2016 dated 11.05.2016 under Sections 420/34 IPC registered at P.S.: Saket, New Delhi.

2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of Respondent No. 2 as well as learned APP point out that during the pendency of the present petition, charges have been framed by the Trial Court against the Petitioner and the said order has been challenged by the Petitioner in Revision Petition being CR.
REV. No. 662/2020.
It is thus urged that the present petition is not maintainable.

3. In view of the pendency of the Revision Petition, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Petitioner, on instructions, seeks to withdraw the present petition, with liberty to raise all issues and contentions raised in the present petition before the Revision Court.
4. Petition along with pending application is disposed of as withdrawn, granting liberty as prayed for.

5. It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case and the Court where the Revision Petition is pending will decide the same uninfluenced by the factum of the filing of the present petition and in accordance with law.
